name: Slide (Path of Iron)
body:
Design manipulation (teleportation); Level 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.
Target you
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You quickly slide between dimensions, teleporting a short but inaccurate distance.

You may teleport up to 30 feet in any direction. You must be able to see your destination in order to teleport. However, when you arrive, you re-enter 1 square off target, as per the rules for thrown splash weapons. If this would place you in an occupied square, you instead arrive in the nearest safe location.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, the range increases by 10 feet.
